description: Base image, Python dependencies and the release workflow's actions. Updates only reach users with the next release (AGENTS.md): merging a Renovate PR doesn't publish anything. Every PR requests a review from 2stacks, which is how the owner gets mail (Dashboard edits send none); majors come as PRs too, with a warning in the body.

packageRules.description: Base image carries a digest; digest PRs bring base-OS fixes
Stay on Python 3.12 until a deliberate upgrade (chromadb and the other deps must support the new version)
Major version bumps: a PR like any other (a review request mails the owner), with a warning in the body
prBodyNotes: **Major version:** read the upgrade guide and every breaking change before merging; tests and the image build must pass. Don't want it? Close the PR: Renovate skips this major until a newer one appears.
